info.name: Credit Bladi API 2.1.0
info.description:
Postman collection of the Credit Bladi API 2.1.0, generated by `scripts/postman/generate-collection.mjs` from the running OpenAPI document: regenerate it after any API change.

**Sessions**: login sets two HttpOnly cookies (`cb_access_token`, `cb_refresh_token`); Postman and Newman keep them in their cookie jar, so every following request runs as the last user who logged in.

**Run it** against the `dev` profile (`docker compose --profile app up -d`): `npx newman run postman/Credit-Bladi.postman_collection.json -e postman/Credit-Bladi.postman_environment.json --folder "1. End-to-end journey"`.

item.name: 1. End-to-end journey
item.description: A complete, ordered scenario on a fresh dev database: staff accounts, simulations, classification, four-eyes rule, decision, disbursement, credit file, client portal and access rules. Every request has tests. A unique suffix per run keeps it repeatable. It logs in four times, under the default limit of five logins per minute.

request.description:
Returns audit log entries (paginated)

Allows the bank administrator to browse the compliance audit trail (logins, simulations, BAM rejections, parameter/role changes), most recent first.

Register a new CLIENT account

Creates a new user with the CLIENT role. Username must be unique.

Refresh access token

Issues a new access token using the cb_refresh_token cookie. Rotates the refresh token on each call (old token is revoked). Returns new cookies and user info.

item.name: Logout: revokes the current JWT and refresh token

request.description:
Logout: revokes the current JWT and refresh token

Clears both HttpOnly cookies and blacklists the access token + revokes the refresh token.

Login

Authenticates with username and password. Sets a signed JWT in an HttpOnly cookie (cb_access_token). Sets a refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie (cb_refresh_token, 7 days). Returns authenticated user info { username, role }.

Get current user info

Returns { username, role } of the authenticated user.

List the caller's own mortgage dossiers (trimmed, client-safe view)

A mortgage borrower has no Enterprise: access is granted per dossier, when the dossier is classified REAL (single client account matching the applicant's e-mail) or by accepting the e-mailed invitation.

Validate a client's declared payment

Confirms the declared payment actually landed on our account: marks the installment PAID and notifies the client. Only valid on a DECLARED installment.

Reject a client's declared payment

The declared RIB/amount could not be matched against the bank statement: reverts the installment to PENDING/LATE and notifies the client with the given reason. Only valid on a DECLARED installment.

item.name: Get a single credit rate record by id

request.description:
Get a single credit rate record by id

Requires a valid MANAGER JWT token.

Partially update a credit rate

Allows the bank administrator to partially update a credit rate record.
Only fields present in the request body are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged.
The change is reflected immediately in every subsequent simulation for the record's
CSP code: no application restart is required, the cached rate is invalidated as
part of this call.

Returns all credit rate records (paginated)

Allows the bank administrator to browse all credit rate records in the back-office.

Simulate a mortgage credit

Calculates the monthly payment and fees for a mortgage credit based on:
- Credit amount (integer, 70,000 – 30,000,000)
- Repayment duration in months (12 – 300)
- Client CSP profile: RETR | SALA | FONC | PROF | INDE
- Nationality code ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. MA, FR)
- Moroccan residency (strict boolean)
- Financing product: CONVENTIONAL (interest-based, default) | MOURABAHA
  (participative: profit margin + VAT on margin, no interest)

request.description:
Upload a document on a demand's current step

Content type is detected from the file's actual bytes (never trusted from the client-supplied header) and checked against the server's whitelist; the file is then antivirus-scanned when scanning is enabled for this environment. If documentType is set and an ACTIVE document of the same type already exists on this demand, it is marked SUPERSEDED instead of being replaced or deleted: nothing is ever removed.

Download a previously uploaded document

Blocked unless the document's antivirus scan verdict is CLEAN or SKIPPED.

item.name: Classify a demand still at CLASSIFICATION_STEP

request.description:
Classify a demand still at CLASSIFICATION_STEP

The account officer's initial validation of a freshly-created demand with the client. REAL attaches the demand to enterpriseId's portfolio and opens INITIATION_STEP (assigned to assigneeUsername, required whenever INITIATION_STEP has a required grade/team). FAKE/SIMULATION_ONLY reject the demand: it stops here, never joins a portfolio, and is never completed in the usual sense.

request.description:
Assign (or reassign) a demand's current step to a specific user

Only a member of the team required by the current step may call this. The target user must have the grade/team profile required by that step ("same profile" Workflow Intégré reference decks, Assignment/Reassignment principle).

item.name: Advance a demand to its next processing step

request.description:
Advance a demand to its next processing step

Closes the demand's current step (only allowed if the caller's grade/team profile matches the one required by that step) and opens the next one in its workflow's pipeline (or the previous one, if returnReasonCode is set), assigned to assigneeUsername. That field is required whenever a step is being opened: i.e. always, unless this call completes the demand (advancing past its last step with no returnReasonCode), in which case there is no step left to assign and it is ignored.

query.description: Rate (%) to preview instead of the demand's current applicable rate.
Amount (MAD) to preview instead of the demand's current amount.
Duration (months) to preview instead of the demand's current duration.

request.description:
Get a demand's amortization schedule, at its current values or an explicit preview

Computes the amortization schedule using the demand's amount, duration and current applicable rate (set at creation and kept in sync by every POST /advance rate decision) by default. Meant to be shown once the demand reaches the last step of its pipeline. Optionally pass rate/amount/duration to preview the schedule at an arbitrary triplet instead: e.g. to replay a past step's own appliedRate/appliedAmount/appliedDuration from GET /{id}/history: without mutating the demand.

item.name: Look up an Enterprise by a free-text company name

query.description: Free-text company name to look up.

request.description:
Look up an Enterprise by a free-text company name

Compares the given name against every Enterprise using a normalized comparison (uppercased, accents/punctuation stripped, common legal-form suffixes like SARL/SA/SAS dropped) rather than an exact string match: used to detect when a demand's free-text companyName (as typed into the public simulator) already corresponds to an onboarded Enterprise before classifying a demand as REAL. Always returns 200; matched=false means no existing Enterprise was found, not an error.

item.name: Open a live notification stream (Server-Sent Events)

request.description:
Open a live notification stream (Server-Sent Events)

Push channel: the connection stays open and the server emits a `notification` event every time NotificationService#notify(NotificationMessage) fires for the caller: the frontend reacts by refreshing the unread count/list, it does not need to poll. A `connected` event is sent immediately, and a comment ping every 15s keeps the connection alive through proxies. Reconnects on its own (native EventSource behavior) if dropped.
